description: Rampant Drone Fabricator (EvEJS PR 379) in a real EVE client: an Ishtar warps onto the Fabricator in a C1-C3 wormhole (J-space 31000018), which starts wave 1; the driver clears waves 1-5 with drones (real kills, the Fabricator ignores GM clears). In the 20 s breaks after waves 3 and 4 the Fabricator takes no damage; in the break after wave 5 it does. Survival is GM help (/heal when armor falls under half), since the check is the site, not the tank. Needs the client-agent patch and an untouched Fabricator in that system. Driver: sites/sites.py.

setup.note: the client character's ship, left in Jita 4-4
board, undock, jump to the system, warp onto the Fabricator: wave 1 starts
waves 1-5 in a tasklet, probing the Fabricator in the breaks after waves 3, 4 and 5
up to about 33 minutes (a run fits in 3000 s); a slower fight needs a stronger hull
no damage before wave 5 is cleared, damage after
